g.title: Engineering command interface (MOD-010)
Implementation sources
main and dispatchMain admit and dispatch commands and select final output; the executable wrapper applies the command-specific logging boundary.
Routes primary recording requests to query or mutation command adapters.
Owns public query admission, literal selection, pagination, and projection. Its inspectSubjects helper also hosts the MOD-011 subject-observation role.
Admits targeted recording intent and connects construction and receipt callbacks to the store.
Admits the advanced inspect/check/record/recover command envelope and dispatches to executeRecordStore.
Serializes primary results and prepares fitting mutation receipts; its observation helpers cooperate with MOD-011.
Implements bounded current-work discovery behind its own public contract.
Wraps eligible command execution with bounded diagnostic events and deferred rendering.
Resolves platform default or explicitly overridden diagnostic directories and validates logging vocabulary.
appendDiagnosticEvent and readRetainedLogs manage the owned bounded diagnostic files and their guarded read/write paths.
findInvocationEvents validates and selects the exact invocation from supported retained events, preserving corruption and unavailability outcomes.
Declares the package entry point, included files, ESM format, and external dependencies.
